denial_type_rationale: Line-level NCCI bundling denial (CO-97) caused by a missing distinct-procedural-service modifier; not a clinical or coverage dispute.
reasons_for: The 29881/29876 edit has modifier indicator 1, so it can be bypassed with a supported XS/59 modifier.
The op note explicitly documents synovectomy of the suprapatellar pouch, patellofemoral compartment and lateral gutter, and states 'No synovectomy was performed in the medial compartment.'
The payer's own policy RP-114 Section 4 lists exactly these conditions for separate reimbursement.
Pathology confirms proliferative synovitis, and the MRI documented it beforehand.
reasons_against: A corrected claim must be received within 90 days of the remittance date.
recommended_strategy: Submit a corrected claim (frequency code 7) with 29876-XS-RT and the operative report attached, plus a short cover letter citing RP-114 Section 4.
